messages.text:
"Create a complete 2D pixel-art mobile MMORPG with a top-down perspective and a fantasy world. The game should have smooth touch controls with a virtual joystick, clickable monsters and automatic combat. Include three playable classes: Warrior, Archer and Mage, each with unique abilities and weapons. Add different monsters such as Slimes, Wolves, Skeletons, Goblins, Orcs and Dragons, with different strengths, XP rewards and loot drops.

Create a large expandable world with villages, forests, caves, dungeons, NPCs, quests, shops and bosses. Include a complete leveling system, character stats, HP, MP, XP, inventory, equipment, weapons, armor, potions, gold and different item rarities. Add a mobile-friendly interface with health bars, experience bars, inventory, skills and a minimap. Character progress must be saved automatically.

IMPORTANT: Build the entire game with a modular and expandable architecture that supports future real-time multiplayer without requiring a complete rewrite. Prepare a server-based backend, central database, unique player IDs, secure accounts and server-side storage for character data, inventory, Gems and Gold.

I also want to add a mobile-friendly web-based admin dashboard later, which I can access from my smartphone. Do not build it yet, but prepare a secure backend API and administrator permissions so I can later manage players, give Gems and Gold, change levels, grant items, ban players, manage monsters, quests, events and drop rates directly from my phone.

Prepare the architecture for future multiplayer features such as chat, friends, trading, guilds and PvP, as well as monetization through premium Gems, VIP memberships, cosmetic items and Google Play or Apple App Store purchases.

Do not implement multiplayer, payments or the admin dashboard yet. Focus on creating a fully playable Android game first. Make sure all implemented features work correctly, save properly and are easy to expand later. The final goal is to create a complete 2D mobile MMORPG that can eventually grow into a full online multiplayer game.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
